limits: bounded two-setting prototype, not selected production behavior
identifiability is checked only against the other blocker-policy setting
generated inputs are sampled from the current production manifold

dependent_input_constraints: same-color endpoint boxes form a midpoint-aligned bridge candidate
a differently colored third box intersects the bridge rectangle
parameter.name: blocker_policy

any_color.racket_text:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((objs (objects g 0))
                  (rects (map (lambda (o)
                                (let ((bb (obj-bbox o)))
                                  (list (obj-color o)
                                        (first bb)
                                        (second bb)
                                        (third bb)
                                        (fourth bb))))
                              objs))
                  (n (length rects))
                  (bridges (for*/list ((i (range 0 n)) (j (range 0 n)) #:when (< i j))
                             (let* ((a (list-ref rects i))
                                    (b (list-ref rects j))
                                    (ac (first a))
                                    (bc (first b)))
                               (cond
                                 ((!= ac bc) #f)
                                 (else (let* ((ar1 (second a))
                                              (ac1 (third a))
                                              (ar2 (fourth a))
                                              (ac2 (fifth a))
                                              (br1 (second b))
                                              (bc1 (third b))
                                              (br2 (fourth b))
                                              (bc2 (fifth b))
                                              (ro-s (max ar1 br1))
                                              (ro-e (min ar2 br2))
                                              (co-s (max ac1 bc1))
                                              (co-e (min ac2 bc2))
                                              (row-ovlp (<= ro-s ro-e))
                                              (col-ovlp (<= co-s co-e)))
                                         (cond
                                           ((and
                                              row-ovlp
                                              (not col-ovlp)
                                              (= (+ ar1 ar2) (+ br1 br2))) (let ((gap-c1 (if (< ac2 bc1)
                                                               (+ ac2 1)
                                                               (+ bc2 1)))
                                                   (gap-c2 (if (< ac2 bc1)
                                                               (- bc1 1)
                                                               (- ac1 1)))
                                                   (br1x (+ ro-s 1))
                                                   (br2x (- ro-e 1)))
                                               (and
                                                 (and (<= br1x br2x) (<= gap-c1 gap-c2))
                                                 (list br1x gap-c1 br2x gap-c2 i j))))
                                           ((and
                                              col-ovlp
                                              (not row-ovlp)
                                              (= (+ ac1 ac2) (+ bc1 bc2))) (let ((gap-r1 (if (< ar2 br1)
                                                               (+ ar2 1)
                                                               (+ br2 1)))
                                                   (gap-r2 (if (< ar2 br1)
                                                               (- br1 1)
                                                               (- ar1 1)))
                                                   (bc1x (+ co-s 1))
                                                   (bc2x (- co-e 1)))
                                               (and
                                                 (and (<= bc1x bc2x) (<= gap-r1 gap-r2))
                                                 (list gap-r1 bc1x gap-r2 bc2x i j))))
                                           (else #f))))))))
                  (valid-bridges (filter (lambda (x) x) bridges))
                  (unblocked (filter (lambda (br)
                                       (let* ((r1x (first br))
                                              (c1x (second br))
                                              (r2x (third br))
                                              (c2x (fourth br))
                                              (bi (fifth br))
                                              (bj (sixth br))
                                              (color (first (list-ref rects bi))))
                                         (not (for/or ((k (range 0 n)))
                                                      (and
                                                        (!= k bi)
                                                        (!= k bj)
                                                        (let* ((o (list-ref rects k))
                                                               (oc (first o))
                                                               (or1 (second o))
                                                               (oc1 (third o))
                                                               (or2 (fourth o))
                                                               (oc2 (fifth o)))
                                                          (and
                                                            #t
                                                            (<= (max or1 r1x)
                                                                (min or2 r2x))
                                                            (<= (max oc1 c1x)
                                                                (min oc2 c2x)))))))))
                                     valid-bridges)))
             (for/fold ((out g))
               ((br unblocked))
               (let ((r1x (first br))
                     (c1x (second br))
                     (r2x (third br))
                     (c2x (fourth br)))
                 (for*/fold ((gg out))
                            ((r (range r1x (+ r2x 1))) (c (range c1x (+ c2x 1))))
                            (set-cell gg r c 8))))))))
